title: Assembling coefficient-unit squares into adjunct transport

source.place: paragraph (1), applying coefficient extension to the positive section class; trace proof paragraph (1), its adjunction

statement: For a ChernCoefficientDiagram x [def-diagonal-uniformizer-chern-transport], a completed local arrow z and a completed direct-image arrow c, assume the first completed-realization square with the explicit coefficient-unit arrow [def-diagonal-coefficient-unit-push]. Then x.TransportTo c holds for the canonical finite adjunct of x.localAdjunctArrow z [def-diagonal-uniformizer-adjunct-conditions]. Here localAdjunctArrow is the inverse of x.localUnitIso, followed by the four functors applied to z and the composite shifted-line endpoints. All scalar mates, finite comparisons, units and line maps are the ones supplied by x.

proof.text: Use scalar_adjunct_transport for the completed and two scalar squares. Use the proved finite_unit_arrow_transport calculation for finite realization. Compose this final square with the proved scalar prefix. The generic nested-transport identity combines the unit inverses, and naturality of q_canonical identifies the final vertical map. finiteUnitAdjunct_naturality identifies the final adjunct.

theorem coefficient_adjunct_transport
    (x : ChernCoefficientDiagram l Y B R A N hN hA hY)
    (z : DiagonalTrace.completedUnit l (ProjectiveLine Y) ⟶
      (DiagonalTrace.completedLine l (ProjectiveLine Y))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
    (c : DiagonalTrace.completedUnit l Y ⟶
      x.tq.Rc.R.obj ((DiagonalTrace.completedLine l (ProjectiveLine Y))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧))
    (first :
      let uP := (x.completedP.F.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).app _ ≪≫
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).mapIso x.completedP.unitIso
      x.completedY.F.mapDerivedCategory.map c ≫
          (x.q_square.derived.iso.hom.app _ ≫
            x.zl.Rq.R.map (x.completedP.shiftedLine l (ProjectiveLine Y))) =
        x.completedY.singleUnit l Y ≫
          (coefficientUnitPush _ Y x.zl.Rq ≫ x.zl.Rq.R.map
            ((uP.inv ≫ x.completedP.F.mapDerivedCategory.map z) ≫
              x.completedP.shiftedLine l (ProjectiveLine Y)))) :
    x.TransportTo l Y c
      (finiteAdjunct A Y (ChernCoefficientDiagram.localAdjunctArrow l Y x z))
